content.short: Qiro Finance is an institutional-grade private credit protocol connecting on-chain capital to emerging markets worldwide.
content.description: Qiro Finance is a pioneering decentralized finance protocol designed to bridge the gap between global on-chain liquidity and high-yield private credit opportunities in emerging markets. The platform provides a robust framework for institutional investors to earn secure returns backed by diversified portfolios of real-world debt. By utilizing a distributed underwriting infrastructure, Qiro ensures that credit risks are assessed by independent experts. Operating across Polygon and Base, Qiro features specialized liquidity pools structured into senior and junior tranches to suit risk profiles.
content.meta: Qiro Finance provides institutional private credit and on-chain debt tokenization. Discover Qiro Finance and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
